items.title: After Indexing is Correct: Hash Join Spills, Splitting Joins Without N+1 & 4 UPSERT Traps
items.description: Advanced database query optimization when indexes are already optimal: Hash Join memory spills to disk, the art of application-side joins without N+1, deterministic SELECT-then-write ID ordering, and 4 dangerous traps of ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.

items.title: Backup & Recovery
items.description: RPO, RTO, backup strategies, point-in-time recovery, logical vs physical backups, and disaster recovery planning.

items.title: Database Connection Pooling
items.description: A complete guide to database connection pooling — how connections work, pool mechanics, HikariCP tuning, pool sizing formulas, failure modes, PgBouncer, RDS Proxy, and production observability. Beginner through senior depth.

items.title: Database Isolation Levels — How to Get It Right
items.description: Deep-dive into all 5 isolation anomalies (dirty read, non-repeatable, phantom, lost update, write skew), the 4 standard isolation levels, PostgreSQL vs MySQL vs Oracle implementation differences, snapshot scope (per-statement vs per-transaction), practical fix strategies without raising isolation, and the spec vs implementation distinction.

items.title: Online DDL: Adding Indexes Safely in Production — ALGORITHM Matrix, Row Log & gh-ost vs pt-osc
items.description: Online Schema Change mechanics in MySQL and PostgreSQL: why staging finishes in 40s while production exhausts connection pools, ALGORITHM & LOCK matrix, innodb_online_alter_log_max_size overflow, gh-ost vs pt-osc, and PostgreSQL's INVALID index trap.

items.title: PostgreSQL BRIN Index (Block Range Index): 99% Smaller Than B-Tree
items.description: Comprehensive guide to PostgreSQL BRIN Index (Block Range Index) — mechanics, 99% RAM and disk space savings vs B-Tree, physical correlation pre-requisite, pages_per_range tuning, and Spring Data JPA integration.

items.title: PostgreSQL Checkpoint Tuning & WAL Buffers: Eliminating I/O Spikes
items.description: Comprehensive guide to PostgreSQL Checkpoint mechanics, Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), checkpoint_completion_target I/O smoothing, pg_stat_bgwriter monitoring, Full-Page Writes (FPW), and Crash Recovery RTO optimization.

items.title: PostgreSQL Heap Storage Architecture & Internals
items.description: Comprehensive deep dive into PostgreSQL internal storage mechanics — 8KB slotted pages, HeapTupleHeader, CTID double-hop lookup, the UPDATE dilemma, HOT optimization, MVCC visibility, and VACUUM mechanics based on Hussein Nasser's database engineering architecture.

items.title: PostgreSQL WAL & Replication: The 380MB No-Op Update, Orphan Slots & 2 AM Disk-Full Playbook
items.description: PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Logging and replication mechanics: why a no-op UPDATE generates 380MB of WAL, replication lag causes, orphan replication slots exhausting disk, silent archive_command failures, and the 2 AM 95% disk emergency playbook.

items.title: Production Database Anti-Patterns: The Seven Tables Every Database Has
items.description: Deep dive into the 7 universal database tables that organically emerge in production systems, technical debt blast radius, and zero-downtime schema hygiene runbooks.

items.title: What PostgreSQL Locks on UPDATE: In-Place xmax, 4 Row Lock Modes, EvalPlanQual & SSI
items.description: Physical engine mechanics of PostgreSQL row locking: how xmax writes locks directly into tuple headers without a lock table, the 4 row lock modes matrix, foreign key collisions, EvalPlanQual rechecks, and why SSI serializable aborts are by design.
